## Scuola Superiore Meridionale

### Probability and Elements of Stochastic Modeling

**Department of Modeling and Engineering of Risk and Complexity (MERC)**  
Scuola Superiore Meridionale, Naples, Italy

**Taught in:** Jan–Feb 2023; Jan–Feb 2024; Jan–Feb 2025; Nov 2025

The course introduces key concepts in probability and stochastic modeling, with emphasis on applications in engineering and science. Topics include probability theory, random variables, Markov chains, and Poisson processes.


### Mathematics and Data Modeling

**Department of Modeling and Engineering of Risk and Complexity (MERC)**  
Scuola Superiore Meridionale, Naples, Italy

**Taught in:** Nov–Dec 2022; Nov 2024–Jan 2025

An interdisciplinary course focused on mathematical modeling, data analysis, uncertainty quantification, and risk assessment, with applications to problems in science and engineering.
